title: What early records were made on
summary: Asked about hot wax, he says New York used the same process as now.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: You were talking at the end of the other tape about the recording process. What did they actually record on when you started recording? What was the material for the -- I'm asking you because Earl Hines told me about a recording session he did in Chicago where it was done on hot wax or something and it got so hot in the studio that the musicians couldn't stand it.
No, not in New York. There was --
Your first recording was in New York?
The same thing that they're using here. The same process.
